title: High School Science Teacher
description:
We are seeking a dedicated High School Science Teacher. Key Responsibilities:
- Plan and deliver engaging science lessons (Biology and Chemistry) to high school students.
- Assess and monitor student progress, providing constructive feedback.
- Create a positive and inclusive classroom environment.
- Participate in parent-teacher conferences and staff meetings.
Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Education or Science.
- Valid teaching certification.
- Passion for teaching and inspiring students.
- Excellent communication and organizational skills.
